edits.rationale: MongoDB's benchmark config notes sliced embeddings aren't normalized and so uses cosine. Voyage's flexible-dimensions tutorial truncates vectors and then normalizes each row to unit length. Voyage's FAQ says full embeddings are unit length, so cosine equals dot product only while vectors are normalized; hence normalize shortened vectors before using dot product. The last sentence is a recommendation that follows from these sources.
